title: Dell launched the XPS 16 Creator Edition in India on 20 Nov 2026, its first XPS laptop on Nvidia's RTX Spark chip, from Rs 4,49,990 (taxes included; base 32GB/512GB); Dell online store from 20 Nov, Dell Exclusive Stores, large-format retail and online partners by mid-December; up to Rs 15,000 cashback (Axis Bank, ICICI Bank); up to 128GB unified memory, 16-inch 3.2K tandem OLED 20-120Hz, 99Wh battery, 17.8mm, SD card slot, HDMI.
headline: Dell's Nvidia XPS 16 Starts at ₹4,49,990 in India

sources.note: page 403 to our fetchers; facts taken from its RSS summary: starting Rs 4,49,990, RTX Spark, up to 128GB, 16-inch 3.2K tandem OLED 120Hz, Dell online store

fact_sources.fact: Launched in India; starts at Rs 4,49,990
Dell's first XPS laptop powered by Nvidia RTX Spark
On Dell's online store from 20 November
Dell Exclusive Stores, large-format retailers, online retail partners by mid-December
Up to Rs 15,000 cashback via Axis Bank and ICICI Bank
Up to 128GB unified memory shared by CPU and GPU
Full-size SD card slot and HDMI port
RTX Spark combines Nvidia Grace CPU and Blackwell RTX GPU on one superchip
